Legs.Subject: BitmapIndex over nine window shapes (a 13-value window of 64 lanes, a one-value window of one lane, a two-value window, a 64-value window of 37 lanes, a window ending at long.MaxValue and one starting at long.MinValue, a three-value window of 361 lanes, a five-value window of 128 lanes and a two-value window of 65 lanes): fresh, after Load of seeded values, and through 200 seeded single-lane Sets whose values fall inside the window, one past either edge or anywhere in a long; Range over every pair of ends within two of the window and the two extreme longs into a destination one word longer than the planes and filled with set bits, the lane reads, Outliers, Words and RangeReads; and the constructor, Set, Load and short-destination refusals.
Legs.Against: A plain scan of an independent copy of the lane values, which calls no BitmapIndex member: the lanes whose copied value lies in each range, the word past the planes left untouched, the lanes whose value lies outside the window, and the count of window values inside the range taken as the lesser of it and its complement plus one, times the lanes' words.
